We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We must produce JSON route where each reaction node uses the given template_id (as integer? example shows number). The route must start from target molecule and go backwards through reactions to precursors (leaf nodes). Each reaction must have children precursors (type mol). We need to apply each template sequentially to generate precursors.

We have applied template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of three SMILES). The result from apply_template gave a tuple of three strings? It returned "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))". So three possible outcomes. We need to choose one that can be further processed by next template 1914389.

We checked matching: first SMILES matches 1914389 (True). The second also True? Actually we checked second and got True earlier. Wait we checked first: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" matched True. Then we applied 1914389 to that and got two precursors: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". So template 1914389 applied to that first precursor gave two products (maybe two possible disconnections). We need to continue with template 1914390 next. Which of these two can match 1914390? We tried both and got False. So maybe need to choose a different branch from earlier.

Maybe the second outcome from 29646: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". Check matching with 1914389 gave True earlier? Actually we checked that and got True earlier. Wait we did check that and got True. Then we could apply 1914389 to that? Let's try apply_template to that second SMILES.
